t: You are looking at Queen Anne's Alcove, a shelter in the City of Westminster. It is credited to Sir Christopher Wren, who designed it. Wren was an architect, astronomer, mathematician and physicist, and he is one of the most highly acclaimed architects in English history. He is best known for St Paul's Cathedral, which he completed in 1710, and for rebuilding many City churches after the Great Fire of 1666. This small shelter is a quieter piece of his work.
